name: Tampa
intro: Prices are in US dollars, with a switch to see them in pounds or euros, before tax and tip (or the service charge some restaurants add). Prices checked October 2026.

localNote.q: How do you book a Michelin star restaurant in Tampa?
localNote.a: Online, and often paid in advance. {r:kosen} and {r:rocca} take tables on OpenTable, as does {r:ebbe}, where the tasting menu is prepaid when you book. {r:koya}, an eight-seat tasting counter, sells its seats on Tock as prepaid tickets, so plan for the whole bill up front.

localNote.q: When do tables open at Tampa’s starred restaurants?
localNote.a: Koya opens the next month’s seats on the 15th at 10am, and with only eight of them they go first. Rocca’s book opens 45 days ahead.

localNote.q: What should you wear to a Michelin star restaurant in Tampa?
localNote.a: Business casual at Koya, which asks for no shorts or flip-flops and as little perfume as possible, and welcomes children only over 12. Smart casual suits the others.

localNote.q: How much should you tip in Tampa?
localNote.a: Prices are before Florida sales tax and tip. Unless a service charge is already on the bill, tip 18–22% of it before tax, as anywhere in the US.
